target_text: template <size_t Cols, bool Aligned = true, bool Dma = false>
body:
**[named bool] named constant used outside an argument position**

Same as line 224, for the k_source_row(const bf16*) overload: default template arguments, parameter names Aligned and Dma adjacent.

Proposed:
```cpp
template <size_t Cols, bool Aligned = true, bool Dma = false>
```
